title: Choose Kindway's visual world
question: The roll assigned Trail Blazes. Keep it, take the pick or the Material standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Trail Blazes
options.lineage: painted trail blazes and hiking-map linework
options.thesis: Every entry is a blaze on your own trail: the app marks the way, never the pace.
options.viewport: Home: date and an invitation in Literata, one Write action, and below it the trail's end with tonight's open blaze waiting to be painted.
options.risk: If blazes appear everywhere it becomes a hiking costume; the mark must stay a small, functional marker.

raised.raise: Pencil before ink: AI-proposed insights and reflections sit in graphite until you confirm them, then they ink to charcoal.
Focus recedes the rest: while you type, the composer fades all chrome except the page.
Same scale every week: weekly review draws each week on an identical frame so no week looks smaller.
One hairline system: a single 1dp sand rule for every divider; no shadowed cards.

options.label: One Page a Day
options.thesis: Each day is one page with its own date block; tonight's page is the app.
options.viewport: Home is today's page: a large date block, a faint grid writing field, a one-line prompt at the foot.
options.risk: Familiar: this is where most journal apps in this category land, and the grid can read as stationery costume.

options.label: Mixtape J-card
options.thesis: Your days as a handwritten tracklist, side A and side B.
options.viewport: A folded tracklist of entries with running dates.
options.case: Nostalgic novelty for some users; weakens calm and clarity on a private journal.
options.risk: Reads as a theme, not a tool.
options.kept: Pencil for tentative, ink for confirmed: AI suggestions stay graphite until you accept them.

options.label: Streaming Wall
options.thesis: Entries as poster rows that expand on focus.
options.case: Binge-browsing grammar works against reflection and invites dependency patterns.
options.kept: Focus dims the rest: the composer recedes chrome while you write.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Patterns as constellations across your entries.
options.viewport: Entries plotted as stars, themes as constellation lines.
options.case: Implies hidden certainty in patterns and conflicts with the warm neutral brief.
options.kept: A fixed ramp: blaze marks come in exactly two sizes, so emphasis never inflates.

options.label: High-density Web
options.case: The opposite of generous writing space.
options.kept: One strict hairline system for every divider.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Your weeks as plates of one plant through its seasons.
options.case: Growth metaphor implies progress scoring, and cream plus sepia is the category rut.
options.kept: Identical scale across time: every week drawn on the same frame.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Mood as a weight axis you drag.
options.viewport: A single letter that thickens with your mood.
options.case: Turns feelings into a slider value, close to the mood-scoring the brief avoids.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast, not by boxes.

canonCard.label: Material 3 journal, played straight
canonCard.thesis: A standard Material You journaling app, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Top app bar, entry list in cards, a FAB to write.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from many journal apps; the notebook feel the brief asks for is lost.
